subject_company: Company whose securities are tendered (target / issuer). In an issuer self-tender, same as bidder. Prefer the operating company / fund name, not law firms or agents.
bidder: Offeror / purchasing party (GLiNER often labels this offeror or purchaser). In an issuer self-tender, same as subject_company. Prefer the company/fund signing the offer — not counsel (e.g. Paul Hastings), depositary, or information agent.
security_description: Short class/type of security being tendered (e.g. common stock / Class I Shares).
offer_price: Consideration for tendered shares. Prefer a cash amount like '$25.00 per share' when present; else NAV phrasing (e.g. 'net asset value per Share as of …'). Copy the best offer_price span value.
currency: Currency of the cash offer price (USD/GBP/EUR…). From explicit code/'U.S. dollars', or infer USD/GBP/EUR from a per-share $ / £ / € offer price in the spans. Skip par value, fees, and aggregate $ millions.
expiration_date: Offer expiration date/time. Prefer temporal spans with high field_cues for expiration (expire / until / offer period). Include time/zone if in the span or window.
withdrawal_deadline: Withdrawal deadline. Prefer temporal spans with withdrawal cues; often same as expiration.
settlement_date: Payment/acceptance timing. If RULES has 'Payment: promptly', use that. Else prefer temporal/rules values with payment/settlement/acceptance cues.
effective_date: Legal effectiveness date (merger closed/consummated/effective, or repurchase as-of). Prefer temporal spans with effective/consummat cues. Do not use bare expiration dates.
minimum_tender_condition: Threshold clause, or exactly "No minimum tender condition" when evidence says there is none.
proration_terms: Pro-rata / oversubscription sentence from evidence. Use "No proration" only if explicitly stated. Preserve numbers (drop thousands commas).
